title: stokesia laevis
intro: Stokesia laevis, commonly known as Blue Sage or Stokes Blue Sage, is a flowering plant native to North America. It is often used in herbal medicine due to its reported health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Stokesia laevis are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
